title: USF Data and Migration Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for data models, persistence contracts, identifiers, relationships, migrations, seed data, fixtures, backup/restore evidence, and retention/deletion concerns. Each declares its kind (data-migration-kinds). Migrations are forward-only and checksum-immutable (a committed migration is never edited); tenancy isolation is preserved; backup/restore emitted and collected evidence (evidence-kinds) is preserved. Governs the ontology concepts Data Model, Migration, and Backup / Restore. lifecycleState draft; not active. GOVERNANCE ENVELOPE: instances MUST carry id, title, description, authorityLevel, lifecycleState, ontologyConcepts, taxonomyRefs, vocabularyRefs, and aiGuidance (schema-authoring-standard section 9/11). Envelope fields kind (artefact-kinds) and version are deviated and intentionally not required: this artefact is not a top-level artefact-kind and instance versioning is deferred to instance-topology definition (recorded deviation per schema-authoring-standard section 9.3).

tenancyIsolation.$comment: e.g. schema-per-tenant with RLS; a contract-level invariant.

authorityLevel.$comment: authority-levels canonical value pinned to this schema's registry authorityRole.

allOf.$comment: A migration is forward-only and checksum-immutable: it declares its order, a checksum, and immutable=true. A committed migration is never edited.
Backup/restore evidence must preserve emitted and collected evidence (fail closed on missing collected evidence).
